title: Where the limiter sits: one check before any expensive work
caption: The gateway asks the shared counter store before forwarding. Rejected requests never reach the API servers or the database.

steps.text: A request arrives at the edge, tagged with its key (user id, API key or IP).
The limiter atomically increments the key's counter in a fast shared store and reads the result: one round trip, about 1 ms.
Under the limit: forward. The API servers and database only ever see allowed traffic.
Over the limit: answer 429 Too Many Requests with Retry-After right away. The rejection costs almost nothing.
